entities.summary: António Luís de Meneses, 1st Marquis of Marialva and 3rd Count of Cantanhede was a member of the Forty Conspirators and a capable Portuguese general who fought in the Portuguese Restoration War, that ended the Iberian Union between Portugal and Spain.
